uncertainty_summary.summary: Across all 12 cases the dominant recurring uncertainty is whether the target region contains the annotated class versus a visually similar alternative (bus vs large van/truck; truck vs large van/bus; motorcycle vs scooter; car vs background fragment). A second recurring theme is whether an IoU shortfall reflects a genuine localization offset versus being a consequence of small object size. A third recurring theme is that several FALSE_POSITIVE labels rest on the annotation set as well as the image (no GT in the region), and that categories such as SMALL_OBJECT and CROWDING are recorded as scene-level contributing difficulties rather than proven causes of any specific prediction.

grouped_themes.theme: class identity ambiguity at image scale
IoU shortfall attributable to localization versus object size
false positive label dependent on annotation set, not only on pixels
duplicate detection is a consequence of greedy one-to-one matching rather than of box quality

observed_findings: All 12 inspected cases were recorded with observed_facts drawn from direct visual inspection of a single image per case.
Every inspected case is a small/distant object; SMALL_OBJECT appears in all 12 cases.
FALSE_POSITIVE_BACKGROUND appears in 5 cases (VC-01, VC-02, VC-03, VC-11, VC-12).
FALSE_NEGATIVE appears in 3 cases (VC-04, VC-05, VC-06), all truck-class.
DUPLICATE_DETECTION appears in 2 cases (VC-07, VC-08), both motorcycle-class on the same image.
BORDERLINE_IOU_MATCH appears in 2 cases (VC-01, VC-03), both bus-class.
LOCALIZATION_ERROR appears in 4 cases (VC-02, VC-04, VC-05, VC-06).
All four object classes are represented: bus (3), truck (4), motorcycle (4), car (1).
11 of 12 cases are from the test split; 1 case (VC-09) is from the valid split.
derived_findings: 12 cases were inspected in total, each exactly once, with no duplicates.
The category counts above are mechanical tallies of the categories explicitly recorded in visual_inspection.json.
The split counts (11 test, 1 valid) are taken directly from the split field recorded in each case record.
not_determinable: The prevalence of any error category across the full dataset cannot be established from 12 selected cases.
Whether a category is representative of the overall detector error distribution is not claimed.
Causality between any recorded category and detector behavior cannot be established.
Statistical significance of any observed tally cannot be established.
Whether an uncertainty about class identity or IoU shortfall would resolve one way or the other cannot be determined without additional evidence.
scientific_scope_note: This summary aggregates evidence recorded during 12 single-image visual inspections performed under the D-03 baseline evaluation protocol. Cases were selected deterministically from matching.json evidence and are not a random sample of the dataset. Counts reported here describe the inspected cases only and must not be generalized to dataset-wide error prevalence, detector performance, or category frequency.
